new_result.statement: If conditional core densities satisfy ||p_{T_z}||_2<=K uniformly over an original-coordinate driver Z and a disjoint cap-one receiver W enters as (2CZ+d)^T W, then ||p_Q||_infinity <= 2^(3/2) K ||C||_op^(-1/2), uniformly in d, dimensions, translations, unbounded supports and fragment geometry.

partner_applied.application: Its affine-uniform slice Fourier estimate is converted by chirp-invariant Plancherel to a uniform L2 core bound and then inserted into the new bilinear receiver theorem.

unresolved_implication: The bare spectral condition s_3(A)>=1 has not been shown to force a partner-certified L2 core plus a disjoint receiver block with universally positive operator norm. Receiver self-curvature and receiver-core cross couplings remain unpaid.
next_step: Seek a structural extraction turning an arbitrary remaining cross bank into the L2 receiver configuration, or extend the receiver estimate to tolerate receiver self-curvature before paying reciprocal local minors.
